title: CLC Scheme Package v1
description: Immutable, content-addressed scheme package. Closed object: undeclared members are refused. The object deliberately has no trusted `authorized`, `verified` or `approved` member; a deployer recomputes authority from the publisher's AIC grant, this package, the matching transition and its own trust policy.

scheme.description: Scheme the package governs. Must equal the CLC-SCHEME-v1 declaration's `scheme`.

revision.description: Two-component scheme revision `major.minor`. `patch` keeps it, `minor` advances the minor component, `major` advances the major component and resets minor to 0.

definition_digest.description: Digest of the exact definition payload bytes pinned by the deployment fixture.

declaration_digest.description: Digest of the exact CLC-SCHEME-v1 declaration payload bytes pinned by the deployment fixture, and equal to the declaration's own `digest`.

change_class.description: Semantic change class relative to `previous_package_digest`. A first package uses `major`.

previous_package_digest.description: Digest of the package this one replaces. Absent only for the first package of a namespace.

publisher.description: Principal the signing certificate's AIC must name. This is a binding to be checked, never an assertion of authority.

generation.description: Monotonic package generation within the scheme namespace. The first package is generation 1.

issued_at.description: Optional issue time. When the deployer's policy sets max_staleness_seconds, a package older than that window is refused.

valid_until.description: Optional expiry. A deployer whose observed_at is later than this instant refuses the package.
